title: Problem-Solution Paragraph
summary: إزاي تكتب فقرة واحدة تسمّي فيها مشكلة مخفية في الشراء أونلاين وتقترح ليها حل واقعي وتبرره (حوالي 150-180 كلمة).

text: A **problem-solution paragraph** clearly names an issue, explains why it matters, and then proposes a specific, realistic solution. It is shorter and more focused than a full proposal or essay.

blocks.text: الـ **problem-solution paragraph** يعني «فقرة مشكلة وحل». إنت بتكتب **فقرة واحدة** بتقول فيها: فيه **مشكلة** معينة، ودي **أسبابها** و**ليه هي مهمة**، وده **حل واحد واقعي** ليها، وده **ليه الحل ده هينفع**.

في الكتاب الدرس ده في **Unit 10: Behind the Buy**، جزء **10.1 Hidden Cost of a Click**، صفحة **Writing in Action** (صفحة 134-135). القراءة بتتكلم عن **التكاليف المخفية (hidden costs)** للشراء أونلاين: عربيات التوصيل اللي ماشية نص فاضية، العلب الكبيرة على حاجة صغيرة، والهدوم المرتجعة اللي بتترمي. والمطلوب فقرة **حوالي 150-180 كلمة** لمجلة المدرسة (**school newsletter**) عن **تكلفة مخفية واحدة** للشراء أونلاين أو ثقافة التوصيل.
وفي **Consolidation Review E** فيه سؤال MCQ: الـ problem-solution paragraph لازم **تقول المشكلة بوضوح وتقترح حل واقعي وتبرره**.

text: Think of a doctor: first he names the illness, then he explains the cause, then he gives one clear treatment and tells you why it works.

blocks.text: الدكتور مبيقولكش «إنت تعبان» وخلاص. بيقولك: «عندك **إيه** بالظبط (المشكلة)، **ليه** حصل (السبب)، **خد العلاج ده** (الحل)، و**هيفيدك علشان كذا** (التبرير)». الفقرة دي نفس الفكرة بالظبط.

items: **مشكلة واحدة بس (ONE specific problem)**: مش «الشراء أونلاين وحش». لأ: «عربيات التوصيل اللي ماشية نص فاضية» مثلًا.
**حل واحد بس وواقعي (ONE realistic, specific solution)**: مش «نبطّل نشتري أونلاين خالص». لأ: حاجة ممكن تتنفذ فعلًا، زي «يوم توصيل واحد في الأسبوع».

blocks.text: والفرق بينها وبين الـ **recommendation report** في Unit 8: التقرير فيه عناوين وأجزاء ورايح لشخص مسؤول، لكن الـ problem-solution paragraph **فقرة واحدة مركزة** من غير عناوين.

text: The book divides the paragraph into five parts. Each part has its own purpose and useful phrases.

rows: قول **المشكلة** بوضوح في أول جملة (topic sentence).
A major problem with… is… / Currently, …
اشرح **ليه** المشكلة بتحصل و**ليه هي مهمة** (النتيجة على البيئة أو الناس).
This happens because… / As a result, …
اقترح **حل واحد محدد وواقعي** واشرح بيتنفذ إزاي.
One possible solution would be to… / A practical way to address this is…
This would help by… / This is effective because…
جملة ختام بتربط الحل بالنتيجة الكويسة.
Overall, … / If this solution were adopted, …

blocks.title: فقرة واحدة = 5 أجزاء جوه بعض
blocks.text: كل الأجزاء دي بتتكتب **ورا بعض في فقرة واحدة** من غير عناوين. تقريبًا: جملة للمشكلة، 2-3 جمل للشرح، 2 للحل، 2-3 للتبرير، وجملة للخاتمة.

groups.title: Proposed solution (من الكتاب)
items: One possible solution would be to…
A practical way to address this is…

groups.title: Conclusion (من الكتاب)
items: If this solution were adopted, … would…

items.en: **A major problem with** online shopping **is** the huge amount of packaging waste.
**Currently,** many customers return clothes after wearing them only once.
**This happens because** returns are free and painless for the customer.
**As a result,** a large number of returned items end up in landfill.
items.ar: بتشرح **النتيجة** وليه المشكلة مهمة. (landfill = مقلب زبالة)

items.en: **One possible solution would be to** charge a small fee for returns.
**This would help by** encouraging shoppers to think before they buy.
**This is effective because** it does not stop people from shopping online.
**If this solution were adopted,** fewer clothes **would** be destroyed.
items.ar: **Second conditional**: If + past (were) ← would + المصدر. بنستخدمها للنتيجة المتوقعة.

blocks.text: قواعد الوحدة اللي تخدم الفقرة: Quantifiers

text: Unit 10 teaches **quantifiers**. They help you describe how big a problem is: **too much / too many, a large amount of, a large number of, few / little**.

blocks.title: حيلة: much و amount مع اللي مبيتعدّش
items: لو تقدر تقول **two / three** قبل الاسم (two vans، three parcels) ← استخدم **many / a large number of / few**.
لو مينفعش تعدّه (waste, packaging, water, information) ← استخدم **much / a large amount of / little**.
**اختار تكلفة مخفية واحدة** من الدرس: half-empty delivery vans / oversized packaging / returned clothes that are destroyed / warehouse workers walking many kilometres.
**اكتب جملة المشكلة** (A major problem with… is…). لازم تبقى محددة.
**اشرح السبب والنتيجة** (This happens because… / As a result,…) واستخدم **quantifier** يبيّن حجم المشكلة.
**اقترح حل واحد واقعي** (One possible solution would be to…) واشرح مين هينفذه وإزاي.
**برّر الحل** (This would help by… / This is effective because…): ليه هينفع؟ وليه واقعي؟
**اختم** بـ Overall, … أو If this solution were adopted, … would…
**راجع**: فقرة واحدة؟ مشكلة واحدة وحل واحد؟ كلمات من الدرس (emissions, landfill, convenience, informed…)؟ حوالي 150-180 كلمة؟

blocks.title: Problem-Solution Paragraph: Half-Empty Delivery Vans
blocks.task: As a student writing for your school newsletter, write a problem-solution paragraph of about (150-180) words about one hidden cost of online shopping or delivery culture. Clearly state ONE specific problem and propose ONE realistic, specific solution.
text: A major problem with delivery culture is the large number of half-empty vans on our streets. Currently, many online shoppers choose free next-day delivery without a second thought. This happens because the option is quick and costs nothing at checkout. As a result, vans often drop just two or three parcels in each street and come back the next day for more, which produces too many emissions. One possible solution would be to offer a weekly "Green Delivery Day" when all of a customer's orders arrive together. Online stores could show this option first and give a small discount to customers who choose it. This would help by reducing the number of trips, since each van would carry consolidated orders instead of just a few items. This is effective because it does not ask anyone to stop shopping online. It simply makes the hidden cost visible and gives customers an informed choice. Overall, if this solution were adopted, our streets would be cleaner and the price on the screen would be closer to the real cost.
blocks.marks: يغطي نقاط الـ Writing Rubric الخمسة في الكتاب
notes: **Problem**: أول جملة فيها المشكلة واحدة ومحددة: **A major problem with delivery culture is the large number of half-empty vans** (عبارة الكتاب + quantifier).
**Currently, …**: بتوصف الوضع دلوقتي (الناس بتختار next-day delivery من غير تفكير).
**Explanation**: السبب **This happens because…** والنتيجة **As a result, …** وليه مهمة: **too many emissions** (quantifier تاني + كلمة من الدرس).

**Proposed Solution**: حل **واحد ومحدد وواقعي**: **One possible solution would be to offer a weekly "Green Delivery Day"** + مين ينفذه وإزاي (Online stores could show this option first and give a small discount). الـ inverted commas حوالين الاسم لأنه **مش اسم رسمي حقيقي**.
**Justification**: **This would help by reducing…** (by + ing) + **This is effective because…**: الحل واقعي لأنه مش بيمنع الشراء أونلاين.
**Vocabulary من الدرس**: emissions, consolidated orders, hidden cost, informed choice, checkout.
**Conclusion**: **Overall, if this solution were adopted, … would…** = second conditional للنتيجة المتوقعة، وبترجع لفكرة الدرس (السعر على الشاشة مش هو التكلفة الحقيقية).
**فقرة واحدة** من غير عناوين، ومكتوبة لقرّاء مجلة المدرسة بأسلوب واضح ومحترم.

blocks.title: غلط ← صح
items: ✗ تكتب 3 مشاكل (packaging + vans + returns) ← ✓ **مشكلة واحدة** محددة.
✗ الحل: People should stop buying online forever. ← ✓ حل **واقعي**: Online stores could offer a weekly delivery day.
✗ One possible solution would be offer… ← ✓ One possible solution would be **to offer**…
✗ This would help by reduce trips. ← ✓ This would help by **reducing** trips.
✗ If this solution was adopted, the streets will be cleaner. ← ✓ If this solution **were** adopted, the streets **would** be cleaner.
✗ too many packaging / a large number of waste ← ✓ **too much** packaging / **a large amount of** waste.
✗ تقترح الحل من غير ما تبرره ← ✓ لازم **This is effective because…**

blocks.text: الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالشكل ده:
**1) MCQ عن الـ genre (زي Consolidation Review E):**

text: Which sentence belongs to the Justification part of a problem-solution paragraph? a) A major problem with online shopping is packaging waste. b) This is effective because it saves cardboard without stopping people from shopping online. c) Currently, many customers order several sizes of the same item. d) One possible solution would be to use smaller boxes.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: b** — **This is effective because…** بتشرح ليه الحل هينفع، وده الـ Justification. (a) و(c) مشكلة، و(d) الحل نفسه.

text: A large … of water may be used to produce a single cotton T-shirt. a) amount b) number c) few d) many

blocks.text: **الإجابة: a** — water مبتتعدّش، فبنقول **a large amount of**.

text: Do you think 'free' next-day delivery is really free? Give evidence for your answer.

blocks.text: **J:** No, I do not think 'free' next-day delivery is really free. **R:** The customer pays nothing at checkout, but the environment and workers pay a hidden cost. **E:** For example, the text explains that vans may deliver only a handful of items to one street and repeat the same half-empty route the next day, so the carbon cost becomes considerable. — لاحظ إن 'free' في inverted commas لأنها **مش بمعناها الحرفي**.
قائمة المراجعة (من الـ Writing Rubric في الكتاب)

items: زيادة: استخدمت **quantifiers** صح؟ فقرة واحدة؟ حوالي **150-180** كلمة؟

blocks.text: **أولًا: اختار الإجابة الصحيحة (a / b / c / d)**

items.q:
1. A problem-solution paragraph is … than a full essay.
a) longer and less focused  b) shorter and more focused  c) more informal  d) more imaginative
items.a: **b** — الكتاب: shorter and more focused than a full proposal or essay.

items.q:
2. One possible solution would be … clearer return policies.
a) introduce  b) introducing  c) to introduce  d) introduced

3. This would help by … the amount of packaging.
a) reduce  b) reducing  c) to reduce  d) reduced

4. If online stores … slower delivery options, emissions would fall.
a) offer  b) will offer  c) offered  d) offering

5. There are too … delivery vans in our street every morning.
a) much  b) many  c) little  d) amount

6. Online orders create a large … of cardboard waste.
a) number  b) many  c) amount  d) few

7. Which sentence is the best Problem sentence?
a) Shopping is fun.  b) A major problem with online shopping is the huge number of returned clothes that are destroyed.  c) I like my new shoes.  d) Overall, it is good.

blocks.text: **ثانيًا: الجملة دي من أنهي جزء؟ (Problem / Explanation / Proposed Solution / Justification / Conclusion)**

items.q: 8. 'This happens because customers are not shown the environmental cost.'
9. 'A practical way to address this is to let customers choose smaller boxes.'
10. 'This is effective because it saves money for both stores and customers.'
11. 'Overall, small changes at checkout could make a measurable difference.'
12. 'Currently, a large amount of packaging is thrown away after one use.'
13. A good problem-solution paragraph discusses as many problems as possible.
14. The solution must be realistic and specific.
15. You do not need to explain why the problem matters.
items.a: **False** — الـ rubric: I explain why it matters.

items.q: 16. 'If this solution were adopted, …' is a suitable way to conclude.
items.a: **True** — دي من عبارات الـ Conclusion في الكتاب.

items.q: 17. There is too many plastic in online deliveries.
items.a: There is **too much** plastic… — plastic مبتتعدّش.

items.q: 18. If customers knew the real cost, they will buy less.
19. One possible solution would be ban free returns.
items.a: One possible solution would be **to limit** free returns. (وكمان **limit** أوقع من ban لأنه أكثر واقعية.)

items.q: 20. Few people knows what happens to returned items.
21. Write a Problem sentence about oversized boxes.
items.a: مثال: **A major problem with online deliveries is that small items are often packed in boxes that are far too large.**

items.q: 22. Write a Justification sentence for this solution: 'Stores could offer reusable delivery bags.'
items.a: مثال: **This is effective because the same bag could be used many times, so a large amount of cardboard would be saved.**

items.q: 23. Write a Conclusion sentence using 'If this solution were adopted'.
items.a: مثال: **If this solution were adopted, fewer returned clothes would end up in landfill.**

text: As a student writing for your school newsletter, write a problem-solution paragraph of about (150-180) words about **returned clothes that are never resold**.

rows: A major problem with free returns is that a significant proportion of returned clothing is never resold.
This happens because it is cheaper for companies to destroy items than to inspect and restock them. / As a result, a large amount of clothing ends up in landfill. / customers see only a free refund.
One possible solution would be to show customers a 'return cost' message at checkout and offer free returns only within seven days.
This would help by making customers think before they order several sizes. / This is effective because it keeps returns possible but more responsible.
Overall, if this solution were adopted, fewer clothes would be wasted.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: الـ problem-solution paragraph = **فقرة واحدة** فيها **مشكلة واحدة** و**حل واحد واقعي**.
الترتيب: **Problem ← Explanation ← Proposed Solution ← Justification ← Conclusion**.
عبارات أساسية: **A major problem with… / This happens because… / One possible solution would be to… / This would help by… / If this solution were adopted, …**
استخدم **quantifiers** (too much / too many / a large amount of / a large number of) علشان توضح حجم المشكلة.
الطول **حوالي 150-180 كلمة**، والحل لازم يكون معاه **تبرير**.
